scope: Preserved prior literature and local education experiments discussed in this thread. Not a repository-wide audit, new API run, or cross-model benchmark leaderboard.
limitations: Generation counts are not correctness counts.
API errors and missing predictions are not model capability failures.
Different metrics, item versions, protocols, and judges are not pooled.
Historical R28 LongTutor results predate official-protocol alignment.
Web sources are linked with verification scope in the document; this snapshot freezes local evidence only.

extra_metrics.metric_note: QWK/CCS/ECS are agreement statistics against human expert labels on a 0-100 scale, computed per subtask over the item population; they are not accuracy and there is no per-item score.
extra_metrics.headline_metric: unweighted mean of the per-subtask value over all subtasks (the 0630 report's aggregation)

extra_metrics.metric_note: QWK/CCS/ECS are population agreement statistics against human expert labels on a 0-100 scale, not per-item accuracy. The generic accuracy field is strict structured exact match and is diagnostic only.
extra_metrics.headline_metric: unweighted mean of each available per-subtask metric

extra_metrics.metric_note: Headline is quadratic weighted kappa against human holistic scores over the official 7,421-essay test split — a population agreement statistic, not per-item accuracy (accuracy is null by design). Unparsed or out-of-range replies are excluded from QWK and counted as bad_format.

extra_metrics.metric_note: arr_w is the official ARR_w (paper Eq. 1) as a percentage; weighted_shifted rescales it to [0,1] against its per-item lower bound and is the closest analog to the internal Fair815 ranking metric (not identical -- different judge and sample subset).
